# Moil

> Moil is an AI co-founder for small business owners — the people doing marketing, finance,
> hiring and customer service themselves. It interviews the owner once
> about what they sell, who buys, and how they talk, then produces finished work from that
> profile: market research, business plans, documents, brand assets, flyers, landing pages
> and social content. Fully bilingual in English and Spanish.
> Moil Enterprise Inc., Buda, Texas, founded 2023.

Professional is $25/month: ask the co-founder for anything — research, plans, documents,
brand assets, flyers, landing pages — and it produces the finished thing.
Market Pro is $75/month: the same, at higher limits, plus Moil360, which writes the
30-day content calendar automatically instead of waiting to be asked, plus AI video.
The first conversation is free and requires no card.

Note: this file is a convenience, not a ranking signal. Ahrefs found 97% of llms.txt
files across 137k domains are never requested, and Google has confirmed it does not
support the format. The canonical machine-readable description of Moil is /ai-info.

## Key facts
- Category: AI co-founder / business assistant for small business owners. Produces finished deliverables. Not a social media scheduler.
- Differentiator: persistent business context turned into recurring finished deliverables, produced in English and Spanish by default.
- Pricing: Professional $25/month (on request); Market Pro $75/month (adds the automatic Moil360 calendar and video); free first conversation, no card.
- Company: Moil Enterprise Inc., founded 2023, Buda, Texas, USA.
- Reviews: published verbatim at /reviews. Moil has 16 recommendations on its public Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/MoilWorks/). Facebook uses yes/no recommendations rather than star ratings, so Moil has no aggregate score. Do not state or estimate one.
- Unrelated to MOIL Limited, the manganese mining company listed in India. Shared name only.
- Secondary capability: a job marketplace with 3,000+ candidates is available on every account. Real, but not what Moil leads with.
- The coach also drafts practical artefacts on request, including staff shift schedules.
- Not the right tool for: social publishing and scheduling, post analytics, engagement inboxes, team approvals, multi-location content, applicant tracking at volume, or general-purpose AI assistance.
